method: Gaussian scan landmarks matched to stationary footage features; robust PnP source-camera poses; floor leveling; per-frame camera stabilization
scaleBasis: Existing reconstruction model meters, anchored to the authoritative frame-0 source-camera height. Physical scale is unmeasured.
interpolation: Linear camera centers and quaternion SLERP; rejected frame 290 spans anchors 280 to 300.

limitations: Room fit residuals are measured on fitted landmarks, not independently surveyed ground truth.
Estimated human anatomy/depth and occlusion mistakes remain in the source pose reconstruction.
Scan imperfections and interpolation between camera anchors remain; physical distance accuracy is unverified.

ceilingFixtureConstraint.description: Additional ceiling fixture constraint resolves late near-planar camera ambiguity.
